news.headline: MAJOR FLOODING SAT — NWS Melbourne Flood Warning remains in effect until further notice for the St. Johns River near Cocoa: stage was 18.7 ft at 8:15 PM Fri, with a 24-hour max of 18.8 ft, forecast to hold steady at 18.8 ft this weekend into early next week (flood stage 16.0 ft); Orlando Sat high 78°F with PM showers, Melbourne thunderstorms likely

Fort Meade data center faces a new vote after plan revisions — Stonebridge shifted the 4.4-million-square-foot hyperscale project west, added a 120-acre wildlife preserve and moved the on-site power plant north; new City Commission approval is expected to be sought by January, with construction in Q2 2027 if approved, generating 4,000 construction jobs at peak

Central Florida builders push fall incentives verified Nov 20 — Dream Finders Homes offers rates from 5.49% on select quick move-in homes closing by Nov 30, Mattamy Homes offers an FHA 5/1 ARM at 4.75% plus closing costs on contracts Nov 9–22 closing by Dec 31, and Taylor Morrison offers a 4.99% conventional fixed rate on eligible quick move-in homes

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition
Copper selloff deepens Fri — COMEX copper ended the week down 9.91% at $5.4770/lb, down 14.80 cents (2.63%) on Fri Nov 20

MasTec to acquire Murphy Corporation for about $1.25 billion in cash — Murphy, a large mechanical contractor with HVAC, plumbing and process work for mission-critical markets, is projected to generate about $775 million in 2026 revenue and about $140 million in Adjusted EBITDA, with about 1,600 employees including about 1,200 union craft professionals
Markets plunge Fri — the S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33 on Fri Nov 20, capping the worst week since April 2025

Mortgage rates rise — Freddie Mac said the 30-year fixed mortgage averaged 7.28% for the week ending Nov 19, up 17 basis points from 7.11%; CME FedWatch on Fri priced about a 91.4% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed hike at the Dec 8–9 meeting

NBA: Magic 113, Nets 111 on Fri night — Franz Wagner scored 35 points including the tiebreaking jumper with 2.8 seconds left, Orlando improves to 7-8 and 3-0 in NBA Cup; Heat 137, Bucks 130 on Wed — Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts, 14 reb, 9 ast in his first game against his former team, Bam Adebayo 26 pts, Miami's sixth straight win
NFL Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers at Lions 1 PM ET (FOX), Dolphins at Bills 1 PM ET (CBS), Jaguars at Giants 4:25 PM ET (CBS)
